The '''MCR-100 Miniprobe''' was a type of small [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Designed by [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]], it was an upgrade from the [[MCR-99 reconnaissance droid]].

==Behind the scenes==
The MCR-100 Miniprobe appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'', as a reward for completing the [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]] storyline.
